ld.r2: pairwise-complete genotype r^2 (statvec.ld_block_sums, shared with the simulations)

meta.polarization: I = 2a = AA cluster (inverted), S = 2+ = BB cluster (standard)
meta.karyofix_note: karyotype_final groups (2a/2a 223, 2+/2+ 97; 619 karyotyped, 2a frequency 0.602). Built by msinv_pboot_wt/results/illex/observed_karyofix/code (observed_kf.py, observed_control2_kf.py, build_observed_ctl2_kf.py); p_obs set to the corrected 2a frequency

meta.classes: I = 2a = AA cluster (inverted), S = 2+ = BB cluster (reference arrangement)
meta.estimator: per-site pi_I, pi_S, dxy with per-site called n (site_stats), summed per bin, then bnd_piratio = sum pi_I / sum pi_S, bnd_dxypi = sum dxy / mean(sum pi_I, sum pi_S)
meta.distance: left d = BP_LEFT - (p0 + 0.5), right d = (p0 + 0.5) - BP_RIGHT, bin k when edges[k] <= d < edges[k + 1]
meta.n_seg: accessible sites with both alleles among the called I and S genotypes
meta.n_sites: accessible VCF sites with >= 1 called I or S genotype

bootstrap.blocks: 10-kb blocks from each bin's inner edge, within the bin, stratified by side for pooled (the site bootstrap is stratified the same way)

sim_mask.rule: sim site at offset j outward from its breakpoint takes the data base's accessibility at the same offset (left base BP_LEFT - 1 - j, right base BP_RIGHT + j)

meta.control: none (raw values, as the simulated boundary_ppc)
meta.undefined: null (a bin with no sites, or a bootstrap with fewer than two blocks)
